info.description: Human Resource Management System - REST API
info.title: HRMS Backend API

get.description: Get the complete feature catalog with all modules and permissions
Get feature access permissions for the currently authenticated user
Get feature access permissions for a specific role

put.description: Update the permissions assigned to a specific role

get.description: Get all manual punch requests with optional filtering and pagination

parameters.description: Filter by status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Create a manual attendance punch request for when biometric/fingerprint fails

get.description: Get all manual punch requests for the authenticated employee

parameters.description: Filter by status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled)
parameters.name: status

get.description: Get all pending manual punch requests for approval
Get a specific manual punch request by ID

delete.description: Delete a manual punch request (soft delete)

post.description: Cancel a pending manual punch request

patch.description: Approve or reject a manual punch request

get.description: Generate a comprehensive report for employees within a date range, combining attendance, timesheet, leave, overtime, and compliance data

post.description: Authenticate user and get access token
Logout the current user. Client must discard the access token after calling this.
Exchange a valid refresh token for new access and refresh tokens to stay logged in

outstanding_salary.description:
Optional: Can be calculated automatically based on employee data
Or can provide custom values

existing_user_email.description: Optional: Onboard user with this email (no credentials at end)

linked_user_id.description: Optional: Onboard this existing user (no credentials at end)

step.description: Optional: Step number (1-10) if providing step data

step1_data.description: Optional: Step 1 data to save immediately (legacy)

employee_id.description: ID of the existing employee to create a user for

role.description: Role to assign: admin, hr, it, manager, employee, or user

username.description: Optional username (auto-generated from employee email if not provided)
Optional, will be generated from email if not provided

from_user_id.description: Required when caller is Admin: the user who currently has the role

role.description: Role to transfer: admin, hr, it, or manager

target_user_id.description: User who will receive the role (typically a normal employee)

punch_count.description: Number of punches for the day
